summary: BRBI BR Partners S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a shareholders' notice, equivalent to a US dividend announcement, disclosing that its Board of Directors on November 3, 2026 approved interim dividends for the third quarter of 2026 totaling R$12,599,484.48, or R$0.04 per common or preferred share and R$0.12 per UNIT (BRBI11). Record date is November 12, 2026, with ex-dividend trading from November 13, 2026 and payment in a single installment on November 26, 2026 in Brazilian Reais, with no restatement or interest. Watch the modest payout's sustainability and ex-date price adjustment.
